  Scenario: AC11 A decision record write failure leaves the archive undone (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given an appraisal report of class "GENERAL05Y" stored on 1 November 2021 on case "RW-2026-000123" with no legal hold
    Given the rwb-decision contract mock fails to record the decision code "DOCRET"
    When JOB-17 runs on 6 December 2026
    Then the document stays in its state and its blob is not moved to the archive tier
    Then the next run picks the document up, the run log holds MSG-P7-003 and an incident is raised

  Scenario: AC12 A role without Reference data C is refused a class load (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the case owner role RW-CASEOWN has Reference data R only
    When the case owner loads table "RETENTION_CLASS"
    Then the system refuses the load with 403 and MSG-P4-002

  Scenario: AC13 Case contract timeout holds the archive (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given an appraisal report of class "GENERAL05Y" stored on 1 November 2021 on case "RW-2026-000789"
    Given the rwb-case contract mock does not answer within 2 s
    When JOB-17 runs on 6 December 2026
    Then the document is counted as an exception of the run and is not archived
    Then the failure names "Case service" in MSG-GEN-006

  Scenario: AC14 Relay down at commit publishes once (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given an appraisal report of class "GENERAL05Y" stored on 1 November 2021 on case "RW-2026-000123" with legal_hold false
    Given the relay is down when the archive commits
    When JOB-17 runs on 6 December 2026
    Then the action row, the decision record and the event row are committed
    Then the relay publishes both once when it recovers, with no duplicate action
